Protecting Our Game from Counterfeit Sellers: A Company Update

Published 2025-03-02 · Cards Christians Like

Discernment was designed, developed, and successfully launched on Kickstarter in 2023. After a successful campaign, we became the exclusive sellers of the game through our website and on amazon.com (ASIN: B0D5C874R9), walmart.com, and TikTok Shop. Since then, Discernment has gained popularity, and we have worked diligently to ensure that every copy sold meets the highest quality standards.

For reference, the original game can be found here:

Kickstarter Campaign:

  • https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cardschristianslike/discernment-whats-beneath-the-babel

Official Website Listing:

  • https://cardschristianslike.com/products/discernment

Identifying Counterfeit Listings

Unauthorized copies of Discernment have appeared online, particularly on Amazon, Walmart and eBay. These counterfeit versions use our copyrighted images, designs, and content without permission. To help customers distinguish genuine copies from illegal reproductions, here are key differences:

  • Updated Box Design: Our packaging was recently updated so that the box now stands vertically for better retail display.
  • Counterfeit Warning: Any listing featuring a horizontally oriented box is an illegally produced counterfeit. We no longer manufacture or sell the game in that format.
  • Official Product Listings: Only our authorized Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop and website listings contain the genuine product.

Beware of scrubbed logo

To help customers avoid fakes, we encourage a comparison of the official version of Discernment with any questionable listings using the images above. If a horizontally designed box is seen, it is not an authentic product from our company.

Why This Matters

Counterfeit games hurt both creators and customers. As the sole owner of the intellectual property (IP) for Discernment, our company has never granted permission for anyone else to reproduce, sell, or distribute this game. These unauthorized sellers mislead customers, damage our brand’s reputation, and violate copyright laws.

Additionally, customers who unknowingly purchase counterfeits may receive lower-quality products that do not reflect the standards we uphold for Discernment. Our team works hard to ensure that every copy sold is produced with care and integrity.

Taking Action

We have taken steps to report these counterfeit listings to Amazon and other online marketplaces. We are actively working to remove unauthorized sellers and protect our brand from further infringement. If you come across any questionable listings, we encourage you to report them.

To ensure you are purchasing an official copy of Discernment, please only buy from trusted sources such as our website or our authorized Amazon listing (ASIN: B0D5C874R9).

How You Can Help

If you suspect a counterfeit version of Discernment, here’s how you can help:
1. Compare Listings – Check the images and box design to see if they match our updated, official version.
2. Report Counterfeits – If you find a suspicious listing, report it to Amazon or the marketplace where it appears.
3. Buy from Trusted Sources – Always purchase directly from our website or the official Amazon listing.

Final Thoughts

As a company, we take the protection of our intellectual property seriously. We remain committed to ensuring that our customers receive the authentic Discernment game experience they deserve. Thank you for your continued support in helping us fight against counterfeits!

If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out through our website. Together, we can keep the gaming community honest and authentic!
